termsAndConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsAndConditions.subtitle: Please read these terms before using Saint Collections. They explain what you can expect from the app and what we expect from you.

use.title: Acceptable Use
use.description: Please use the application responsibly and only for lawful purposes. Do not attempt to misuse features, bypass permissions, or interfere with how the app works for others.

dataResponsibility.title: Data Responsibility
dataResponsibility.description: You are responsible for checking your import sources, keeping backups when needed, and verifying that your collection data is correct before making buying or business decisions.

changes.title: Service Changes
changes.description: Features and screens may change over time as we improve the platform. By continuing to use the app after updates, you agree to the latest version of these terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Need help with access, data, or behavior? Reach out through the channels below.

expectations.title: Response Expectations
expectations.description: Standard support requests are typically answered within 1-2 business days.

about.title: About Saint Collections
about.subtitle: A professional collector workspace designed to organize figurines, monitor trends, and support informed collecting decisions.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.description: Saint Collections helps collectors centralize inventory, discover release activity, and maintain accurate records across marketplaces. The platform combines catalog exploration, ownership tracking, analytics, and matching workflows in a single workspace.

whatYouCanDo.title: What You Can Do
whatYouCanDo.step1: 1. Browse and filter figurines by lineup, status, anniversary, and market attributes.
whatYouCanDo.step2: 2. Track real-time prices from stores and compare market changes across listings.
whatYouCanDo.step3: 3. Organize personal collections and use charts and matching tools to evaluate trends and align listings with your catalog.
